Group rides in Missouri

9 recurring group rides around Missouri: 5 social, 4 road, 1 gravel. 5 roll on weeknights, 3 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with KC Critical Mass in Kansas City — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? South Side Cycling Club Wednesday Evening Ride runs beginner (up to 10 mi in 1:45), party pace 12–13 mph, intermediate 14–15 mph, advanced 16+ mph.
